data.name: Samyak
data.gender_notes: Samyak is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Samyak means 'perfect', 'complete', or 'right' in Sanskrit and Hindi. It is a name that evokes a sense of harmony and balance, reflecting the idea that everything in the universe operates according to a perfect cosmic order. The name Samyak carries the meaning “Perfect, Complete, Right” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Samyak usually hope their child will grow to embody perfect, complete, right and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Samyak is a spiritual name that signifies the ultimate truth and the harmony of all things in the universe. It is a name that resonates with the deepest spiritual aspirations of the human soul and inspires one to strive for truth, justice, and balance in all areas of life.
data.etymology: Samyak belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Perfect, Complete, Right.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Samyak total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

historical_references.reference: The name Samyak is derived from the Sanskrit word 'samyak' which means 'perfect' or 'complete'. It was used as a personal name during the later Vedic period (1000 BCE - 500 BCE) in ancient India.

historical_references.reference: During the medieval period (500 CE - 1300 CE) in India, the term 'Samyak Samaj' (meaning 'perfect society') was used to describe the ideal social order as envisioned by various Hindu philosophies and religious traditions.
